builds.name: Tank

matchups.why: engage early to bait their CC immunity before your team commits stuns.
negates Mercy of Heaven's heal - burn them down quickly rather than trading slow.
knocking a Longsword down is the fastest way to end the fight - you've only got Shield Bash and Sally Forth to break CC.
tanky units to go very aggressive in a push or defence with. - house playbook

matchups.vs: A tank Shortsword (SnS) or Poleaxe (PA) anchor
matchups.why: Longsword pulls focus especially combined with a tank SnS or PA - your DPS need to follow very close behind. - house playbook

techniques.name: Animation canceling
steps: Training room: try roll-canceling, dismount-canceling and blocking on every skill to learn which are cancelable.
techniques.rhythm: Amya: EVERY CLASS CAN DO IT! - Blocking is the primary cancel; roll canceling interrupts full spells, dismounts, and creates movement otherwise impossible. Costs extra stamina.

techniques.name: Active blocking
steps: it can be BROKEN and stagger you
techniques.rhythm: Don't get "Block checked" - Being an active blocker prevents undesired skills landing on you - relevant against Nodachi/Glaive/Poleaxe CC kits especially, given Longsword's own frontline role.

techniques.name: Horse-whistle CC immunity
steps: Time the whistle on the enemy CC
you take damage but no CC
techniques.rhythm: bugs out with PIN/LOCK skills, so care

techniques.name: Walk into braced units
steps: Walk (don't sprint) into their minimal range
techniques.rhythm: brace damage scales with your speed towards them - For braced units like Forte, Halberds, Phalanx - niche: enemy hero outnumbered, unaware or afk.

gameplay.text: Its role to go first in and try to pull/soak up enemies attention/damage as much as possible while pushing forward 24/7. Trust in how much damage it can absorb/pull focus (especially combined with a tank SnS or PA) with correct unit(s) - but we need DPS to follow very close behind. - house playbook

Primary role - support your team: provide buffs and healing, especially via the rune Mercy of Heaven, which boosts allies' defenses by 10%. Apply this buff to your frontline at crucial moments to help them hold position and withstand enemy attacks; proper timing and positioning are key to maximizing the buff's effect.

Secondary role - disrupt the enemy: against melee-heavy teams, use stuns and crowd control to break enemy formations and create openings for your team. Against cavalry-reliant enemies, intercept and disrupt their charges - stun cavalry mid-charge to prevent them wreaking havoc. Against Xuanjia heavy cavalry specifically: engage early to force them to burn their CC immunity, letting your teammates follow up with stuns to neutralize them.
Dominate melee battles with a brutal combination that balances offensive and defensive capabilities.

positioning.intro: Where to be during a fight:

bullets.text: Go first in, frontline, in any push or defence - it's Longsword's role to pull enemy and unit attention while pushing forward 24/7. - house playbook
Spear Sergeants, Spartans, ISG - go very aggressive in a push or defence. - house playbook
Pair with a tank Shortsword or Poleaxe anchor - you both absorb and pull focus, but your DPS need to follow very close behind. - house playbook
You move 20% faster for 10s after using a skill (24% with a rune), even while blocking - get up into the enemy's face, it makes it harder for their arty to hit you. - house playbook
Units, not enemy heroes, are the real threat here - the only hero class worth real caution is Spear. - house playbook
Stay near your team - Longsword is made for walking the thin line of almost being out of position, not for going it alone. - house playbook

you move at ordinary speed even while blocking with right click, and 20% faster for 10s after using a skill (24% with a rune) - use it to get up into the enemy's face before their arty can track you. - house playbook

bullets.lead: Mercy of Heaven is your sustain tool:
bullets.text: time the heal to land on your frontline at crucial moments, not on cooldown.
engage early to force them to burn their CC immunity, so your teammates can follow up with stuns.
Stun cavalry mid-charge, not after - that's what stops the charge from landing at all.
Vs melee-heavy teams, use your stuns and CC to break their formation and open space for your team.
balance between buffing your team and disrupting the enemy is essential for effective Longsword play.
fire, bleed, or poison on you voids Mercy of Heaven - don't lean on it while trading into DoT-heavy enemies.
Shield Bash removes Dazed, Sally Forth removes Daze - don't burn either before you actually need it.
Shield blocks most attacks, and With Valour III, Sally Forth, and Clash of Shields all knock down - lean on the shield, save the knockdowns.
